idea: Feelings & kindness – SHARING (THE BEACH, picnic blanket): the lid of Baby Jimmy's little yellow picnic box pops open and TWO big red strawberries bounce up right beside his face ('Wow! Look! Two strawberries!'); chorus 'Share, share! Sharing is caring!'; Daddy Tom kneels down and shows his empty hands ('Oh! Daddy has none! Hmm...'); Jimmy gives him one – 'One for you! One for me!'; copy-me 'Hold out your hand! Here you go!'; 'Daddy says thank you! Yum, yum, yum!'; Jimmy asks the viewer 'What do we do? Hmm?' (pause) – 'We share! Sharing is caring! Yay!'; lesson 'One for you, one for me!'. Loop: the hook framing again, the box open and empty, Jimmy and Daddy waving bye-bye.
lesson: Sharing is caring: when someone has none, we share – one for you, one for me.
place: THE BEACH (text-only block, first video in this place)
calendar: Tuesday slot 2 – Feelings & kindness (please/thank you done 3 Nov; today: sharing).
characters: BABY JIMMY: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby boy with fluffy curly ginger hair, big blue eyes, light freckles, rosy cheeks. wearing a light blue t-shirt with a small yellow star, navy blue shorts and white sneakers with yellow laces.

DADDY: a friendly young father in 3D Pixar style, short dark brown curly hair, a short neat dark brown beard, warm brown eyes, thick eyebrows, big happy smile. wearing a loose light green t-shirt, beige loose chino trousers and white sneakers.
setting: THE BEACH: a sunny beach with soft golden sand, gentle blue waves, a striped umbrella and seashells.

supporting_objects.picnic: a small round plain yellow picnic box with a lid; exactly TWO big shiny bright RED strawberries with green leafy tops, toy-like and cute; a plain light blue picnic blanket.

learning.goal: Share with someone who has none: one for you, one for me.
target_words: one for you, one for me
learning.shown_how: Jimmy has two strawberries, Daddy has empty hands; Jimmy gives one, then each holds one and both eat happily.
learning.song_repeats: share 0:03 (x3), 0:23 (x2) = 5x · 'one for you, one for me' 0:10, 0:26 · thank you 0:16
learning.interactive_moment: 0:19-0:21 'What do we do? Hmm?' + 0:21-0:23 humming pause → 0:23 'We share! Sharing is caring! Yay!' + cheer + confetti
learning.copy_me: 0:13-0:16 'Hold out your hand! Here you go!' (Jimmy holds out the strawberry)
learning.fact_check: Exactly two strawberries in shots 1-4 (two in the box / two in Jimmy's hands / one each), none in shot 5; box empty from shot 2 on.
learning.modeling: Jimmy notices Daddy has none and shares kindly by himself; Daddy says thank you; nobody grabs.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, one baby + Daddy (allowed Tue slot 2), bright calm beach, big faces, nothing scary, adults never touch the baby.

fun_mechanics: surprise hook: the box pops open, strawberries bounce up
say-it-with-me chorus: share, share! sharing is caring
copy-me: hold out your hand, here you go
interactive pause: What do we do?

story_order.Daddy Tom: absent shot 1, from shot 2 on (7 s)
story_order.strawberry given: Jimmy holds both in shot 2, gives one in shot 3, one each in shot 4
